items.title: Narvin Kimball Interview, 1961-11-25
items.q: Lord Jack Willis that plays trumpet, he taught him to play music.

ctx.x: Would he be in the phone book?

I'm sure that he is. I'm sure that he is. He's responsible for many musicians, many good musicians. Lord Jack Willis that plays trumpet, he taught him to play music. Al Goodman, the bass player, you've heard of him? Heard of him, yeah. He's a very fine bass player. Another fellow that they called Foots is a drummer.
Oh yeah, I heard of him.
